items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010

ctx.x: Let me run a couple of names by you and just get your impression of these musicians. One is Cannonball Adderley.

Tremendous respect. Loved him. Tremendous talent. Great, great musician. Great, great man. And you know the thing I learned from him? Somebody asked him once, said, “Mr. Adderley,” they said, “do you consider yourself a great or big man?” And Cannonball said to him, “Well a big man is judged by someone other than one’s self.” Hey, Hello? I mean a lot of people could say the same thing. Hello? See that’s another Virgo. I have tremendous respect for Cannonball Adderley, and his brother. You see what I’m saying. As…
